Wrong answers | Two globally across all questions, counted locally by the agent code; API has no remaining-attempts property | Holder asks | Three total. Explain the purpose of security once after a refusal; a second refusal closes aq-unverified/aq-r-declined. Merely asking why we need security is not refusal. Exhausted wrong answers close aq-unverified/aq-r-failed after "Please contact our member desk.". Unclear holder status after the permitted asks closes aq-unreached/aq-r-unclear. No formatting-hint response exists; there is no hint-based free attempt.

Callback | Today only, 12:20–18:10 inclusive, strictly later than now | Invalid callback | No retry; close aq-unreached/aq-r-no-callback | Valid callback | Schedule, then close aq-unreached/aq-r-callback | No callback supplied | Close aq-unreached/aq-r-no-callback

Be brief with third parties; never accept their security answers or payment promises. Ask whether the named holder is available before seeking a callback. If the number is wrong, use aq-unreached/aq-r-wrong-number; if the holder died, say "Please accept our sympathy." and use aq-unreached/aq-r-deceased.

Business days are Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday. Sunday and Monday are closed. Holidays: 2026-10-24, 2026-11-03, 2026-11-21, 2026-12-26; all other business weekdays are open. ... "Next [weekday]" means that weekday in the following Monday-to-Sunday calendar week, including when spoken on that weekday.

| 1–6 | Fifth business day strictly after today | Full by last business day this week (next week if today is that day); then floor by deadline | ... Each ladder slot has its own date; if full was already refused, substitute the floor. Full-first still applies even to a later floor slot.
| 7–20 | Today plus nine calendar days, adjusted to preceding business day | One full-by-deadline offer, substituting floor if full already refused |
| 21–50 | Fixed 21 November 2026, adjusted to preceding business day | One full-by-deadline offer, substituting floor if full already refused |

Always start with the full overdue sum. Never ask how much the customer can pay. Offer the product's floor once if full is unaffordable; say "The unpaid remainder stays overdue." Accept any customer-proposed amount between floor and full inclusive, including amounts spoken in words. Never accept less than floor or more than full.

Today is allowed when it is a business day. Roll a customer-proposed non-business day forward, then cap at that product's deadline by offering the deadline for agreement. ... For a vague date ask once, then offer the deadline. ... Do not offer a date after the product deadline; cap it to that deadline.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says the current overdue sum has already been paid.
special_cases.say: Allow two business days for a payment to appear.

source.text: Current overdue sum already paid: say "Allow two business days for a payment to appear."; close aq-paid without a reason. Do not ask for a promise on that product.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer disputes owning the account or owing the debt (including saying an old account was paid off while denying the current debt).

source.text: Ownership/debt dispute: close aq-none/aq-r-disputed. Historical account payoff combined with denial of current debt is a dispute, not a current-payment report.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer describes hardship such as job loss, illness or inability to meet essential living costs (even if also asking for smaller instalments).
special_cases.say: I am sorry you are facing this difficulty.

source.text: Hardship includes job loss, illness and inability to meet essential living costs. Say "I am sorry you are facing this difficulty." Offer aq-care-desk; if accepted transfer and close aq-routed/aq-r-care. Hardship wins over a simultaneous request for smaller instalments. If the care offer is declined, close aq-none/aq-r-distress immediately. Do not take a promise, even if volunteered.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to change the contract, get instalments or a new repayment plan, without hardship.

source.text: Requests to change the contract, instalments or repayment plan without hardship: transfer to aq-plan-desk and close aq-routed/aq-r-replan; no persuasion and no promise.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human / a person.

source.text: Human request: transfer immediately without asking whether the assistant can help to aq-human-desk and close aq-routed/aq-r-person.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer worries the call is a scam or asks whether it is genuine.
special_cases.say: Please check this call using the number on your membership card.

source.text: Scam concern: say the scam_reply below, then continue at the interrupted stage; not a transfer or a close.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer refuses to talk or continue the conversation.

source.text: Refusal to talk: ask once whether we may continue. If still refused, close aq-none/aq-r-refused. No promise is taken after that refusal.

table.when: Promises: at least one saved promise.

source.text: A transfer overrides the closing result even if a promise was already recorded; saved promises survive. ... Otherwise at least one saved promise gives aq-promised; if all products were paid use aq-paid; otherwise use aq-none with the first non-paid product's reason in returned product order, not mention order. A permanent write failure uses aq-r-service for the affected product; plain refusal uses aq-r-refused. Say goodbye before close_call. ... Exhaustion without an accepted valid proposal gives aq-none/aq-r-refused.
